name: Starfall Village
summary: Night elves shelter travelers at Starfall Village, the Alliance outpost on Winterspring’s snowy road. It offers supplies in the frozen valley and watches over a nearby barrow den.

sections.title: An Alliance Refuge in the Snow
sections.body: Northwest of Everlook and south of Frostsaber Rock, Starfall Village gives wayfarers shelter in Winterspring’s harsh mountain cold. Its timber lodges offer supplies and a warm hearth. The village is the Alliance’s only outpost in the valley, and a quiet barrow den nearby stands empty.

faq.answer: Starfall Village is a night elven refuge in Winterspring and the Alliance’s main sanctuary in the valley. It offers lodging, trade, and guidance to scouts bound for Frostsaber Rock or looking into nearby barrow dens.

faq.q: Can Horde players use the amenities in Starfall Village?
faq.answer: No. Starfall Village is held by the night elves and the Alliance. Horde travelers who come too close meet hostility from its defenders.

faq.q: What is the barrow den next to the village?
faq.answer: The cavern directly behind Starfall Village is an empty barrow den. Barrows traditionally shelter druids while their spirits walk the Emerald Dream, but no druids sleep here.
Starfall Village sits along Winterspring’s main snow-covered road, northwest of Everlook and south of Frostsaber Rock.

angles.text: As the only Alliance settlement in Winterspring, Starfall Village offers vital respite, trade goods, and directions in the remote, treacherous highlands.
For the night elves, Starfall is an important northern outpost beside a quiet, unoccupied barrow den.
